name: Case Sensitive User Login
description: Adds an extra validate handler to the core user login form that requires the entered username to match a stored username with an exact-case '=' DB lookup. Purely additive/restrictive; whether it actually enforces case depends on the users_field_data column collation.
project_description: This module changes the Drupal login username comparison to be case-sensitive. Core Drupal login is case-insensitive: with a username 'admin' you can normally log in as 'admin', 'Admin', 'ADMIN', etc. This module adds a validate handler to the user login form that looks up the entered name with an exact-case match and rejects the attempt when no case-exact user exists, so 'Admin' no longer works for account 'admin'. It affects only the login form; it does not change registration, password reset, programmatic/API logins, or any other core functionality, and it has no configuration.
